items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: his name is Leonard Brown, he teaches up at Northeastern University

ctx.x: That’s the way it should be.
Keep it going. I have a question that was asked by a friend of mine, his name is Leonard Brown, he teaches up at Northeastern University and this will be the 26th year
that he’s held the annual John Coltrane Memorial Concert. And he said, “Anthony could you ask Elvin, ‘What does music mean to him?’”
